verses.text: Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

segments.text: Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

verses.text: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

segments.text: O my God, in thee have I trusted,
Let me not be put to shame;
Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.text: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.

segments.text: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame:
They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.

verses.text: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.

segments.text: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah;
Teach me thy paths.

verses.text: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.

segments.text: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me;
For thou art the God of my salvation;
For thee do I wait all the day.

verses.text: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.

segments.text: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness;
For they have been ever of old.

verses.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness’ sake, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions:
According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me,
For thy goodness’ sake, O Jehovah.

verses.text: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

segments.text: Good and upright is Jehovah:
Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

verses.text: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.

segments.text: The meek will he guide in justice;
And the meek will he teach his way.

verses.text: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

segments.text: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth
Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.text: For thy name’s sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

segments.text: For thy name’s sake, O Jehovah,
Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

verses.text: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.

segments.text: What man is he that feareth Jehovah?
Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.

verses.text: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.

segments.text: His soul shall dwell at ease;
And his seed shall inherit the land.

verses.text: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.

segments.text: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him;
And he will show them his covenant.

verses.text: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.

segments.text: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah;
For he will pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.

segments.text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me;
For I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.

segments.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged:
Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.

verses.text: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.

segments.text: Consider mine affliction and my travail;
And forgive all my sins.

verses.text: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.

segments.text: Consider mine enemies, for they are many;
And they hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.text: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.

segments.text: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me:
Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.

verses.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.

segments.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
For I wait for thee.

verses.text: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.

segments.text: Redeem Israel, O God,
Out of all his troubles.
